title: PVG materiality and measurable analytic gain
pvg_object: a geometric reformulation in valuation space
ant_object: a demonstrable reduction, invariant, tool selection, sharper estimate, or new theorem unavailable from notation alone
forward_translation: Classify PVG as material only when it produces a measurable gain such as a natural observable, shorter proof, correct tool routing, obstruction certificate, or improved bound.
reverse_translation: An ANT result may admit a geometric interpretation, but the interpretation is material only if it changes understanding or capability by a stated criterion.
preserved_information: the classical statement and any explicitly measured gain
lost_information: a visual or terminological change alone supplies no new analytic information
trigger: A classical identity is redrawn geometrically or a PVG label is proposed as a mechanism.
typical_output: material bridge, useful exposition, decorative reinterpretation, or rejected mechanism
error_or_wall: Aesthetic clarity can be mistaken for a theorem or analytic mechanism.
required_certificate: Name the gain, compare against the classical formulation, and show the gain survives removal or ablation of the PVG layer.
positive_example: The margin-interior geometry generated I_r and predicted its local layers, so it was materially useful for discovery.
counterexample: Renaming tau(n) as divisor-box volume without new deduction is decorative.
anti_overclaim: Geometry is not material merely because the picture is correct.
